title: COUNTROWS of the one-side table sees the filter coming from the many side of a both-direction relationship

source.quote: the filter automatically propagates from Sales to Product
source.supports: the filter goes from Sales to Product when the relationship is bidirectional

source.quote: The product slicer now lists a single option: T-shirt
source.supports: same rows; Australia leaves one product

derivation: United States is CUST-01: Sales rows 1 and 2, SKUs CL-01 and CL-02: 2 products. Australia is CUST-02: row 3, SKU CL-01: 1 product. The Hat (AC-01) has no sales and is in neither.
